haikus.text: dark stars fuse and blow / from their crash the cosmos sings / for creating gold
the singer's high note / made my teacup shiver, see / I clapped with both feet
velvet chair, so soft / I sank in and lost an hour / worth every minute
sparkly jukebox hums / pressed all the little keys twice / it played them all, yay
a moth on the stage / dancing in the spotlight beam / star of the evening
tip jar full of coins / I put one in, then two more / it is my hobby
fluffy dumplings, warm / the imp cook winked, gave me two / my day is now good
mummy lost a wrap / I found it, rolled it up neat / high fives all around
the mirror ball spins / little lights on my green nose / I am so fancy
kobold drummer sleeps / between the beats, I promise / listen, tiny snores
I tried to sing too / ghosts politely drifted off / I will practice more
paper lanterns glow / each one has a doodled face / I drew the winky
sat in the front row / the song went right through my chest / now my heart has wings
one tiny teacup / shared between three thirsty imps / friendship by the sip
the stage lights are warm / like a sunrise made for us / underground sunrise
I saved you a seat / it is small, and a bit wet / sorry, spilled my tea
clapping is my job / I am very good at it / listen to this one
a crane made of light / landed softly on my head / I did not move once
goblin ballet night / we hop, trip, and hop again / the ogre wept, proud
cookie in my pouch / been saving it for a week / now it is a rock
the dice said hello / I said hello back to them / we are friends for now
shiny floor, so clean / I can see my own round face / I wave, it waves back
the curtain goes up / everybody holds their breath / even the candles
a wish on a coin / tossed it in the fountain, plop / wished for more cookies

battle_haikus.text: ow, that was my toe / I only have the one toe / now I am quite cross
you hit like a leaf / a very determined leaf / okay, that one stung
I had a nice day / then you came and poked at it / rude, but I forgive
my hat fell off, see / that hat was my favorite / prepare for tickles
en garde, my new friend / I practiced in the mirror / the mirror lost twice
you scuffed my nice boots / they were almost nearly clean / now I fight, with care
swing, miss, swing, miss, swing / this is like a dance, I think / may I lead this time
I counted to three / you did not wait for the three / goblin rules, you lose
that scratch will not heal / until snack time, which is soon / so I will be fine
my grandmother hits / harder, and she is a cloud / do not ask, just duck
I am very small / which means you are a bad aim / wave your arms more, see
big hero, big boots / stomping through my tidy hall / I just swept that, hey
ow. hm. okay. yes. / that is a feeling I felt / now you feel one too
my club is named Bob / Bob has never lost a fight / Bob is also me
you poked the goblin / the goblin is now awake / the goblin has thoughts
fine, I will fight back / but after this, tea? my treat / bring your own teacup
that nearly hurt me / nearly is my middle name / Goblin Nearly Jones
I blink, you swing, miss / I blink again, you miss, swing / blinking is my shield
round one goes to you / round two I will try harder / there are many rounds
a bonk for a bonk / that is the law of the hall / here comes your bonk, friend

yakuza_goblin_phrases.phrase: Listen up, you gold-plated amateur—either cough up the tribute or prepare to be folded!
Nice armor, shame about the structural integrity. Pay the toll, or I’ll crease you myself.
You’re dancing on the edge of a paper cut, boss. Bet the farm or get chopped!
I’ve seen better odds in a trash compactor. Put it on the felt or get lost!
Keep your space-dust philosophies for the afterlife; out here, it’s cash or combat!
You talk like a nebula, but you smell like a loser. Toss the coins or take the hit!
I’m the boss of this fold, and the boss says: bet big or bleed out!
Your stars aren't aligning, pal. They're just blinking at your empty pockets!
Bet it or jet it, champ — the table doesn’t date maybes.
Chip in or ship out, partner. The cards don’t cuddle cowards.
Slide a stack or step back — this table only flirts with risk-takers.
Place a bet or save your sweat, this isn’t a sightseeing tour.
Cash on the felt or feet to the exit — the house can’t wait forever.
C’mon, meatbag, bet or be gone—I got souls to swindle.
Put coins on the table or take your hope elsewhere, sparklehead.
Gamble, gamble, gamble… or scram, I’m not a therapy goblin.
Lay a bet down, clown, or waddle off to safety.
Gold or silence. Your coins talk, your feet can walk.
Toss your fate in the pot, or trot-trot-trot out the door.
Spin the risk wheel, mortal, or vanish in a puff of cowardice.
Pay to play, little hero, or go be brave somewhere else.
Drop a coin and dance with doom… or shoo, I’m busy ruining other lives.
Bet big or begone—I only snack on reckless souls.
Your luck ran out, human. My blade is sharp and my patience is zero.
Don't look at the stars, look at the blade. It's the only reality you're getting tonight.
I don't care about your destiny. I care about your purse.
You're not a hero, you're a walking wallet. And I'm a mugger.
Folded into a corner, just like your chances of winning.
